journeys.title: Standalone employee assessment, assignment and retained results
invariants: Authoring and assignment create no course, lesson or enrollment.
Published assignment revisions and completed attempts remain immutable when current questions change.
Server start, frozen snapshot, saved answers, deadline and attempt limit own the result; concurrent requests and replays do not create duplicate attempts/results.
The assigned employee sees public questions without keys/explanations and only their own tenant-bound assignments.
Mixed invalid audience is rejected atomically; ordinary users cannot delete evidence; existing explicit whole-tenant purge remains ordered and scoped.
journeys.dev_gate: Use permanent ordinary QA roles; create/publish/assign, fail/retry/pass/reload, edit revision and reconcile both retained histories. No model or course creation.
journeys.production_gate: After exact image/schema/frontend and rollback gates, repeat the ordinary-role full journey in the permanent synthetic production tenant and retain fixtures. Customer data unchanged.
